verdict.rationale: Loops can be automated headlessly. It offers a terminal CLI for managing contacts, events and transactional email, installable via curl, Homebrew, PowerShell or Go, and every command supports JSON output (-o json) for scripting plus multi-team auth. It also has a REST API with Bearer-token API keys and a published OpenAPI spec, all of which fit unattended scripts and CI jobs. missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD integration guide (e.g. GitHub Actions example), documented non-interactive/env-var auth for the CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
